title: Suggestion for commitment improvement
body: I really love the app and use it for a long time but i think if a streak counted was added I would feel more committed. Like if you log in your habits for the day whether you did it or not like write skip like just that you have done something at least , then there will be a place to see your streak and the number of days you have done it for continuously. Anyways love the app and I hope you consider my idea! :)
author: Dahail

title: Awesome app , love the widgets
body: I tried a lot of different habit tracking apps and finally ended with this one. Very simple , clean and to the point. I want to have weekly / monthly / daily habits and need to track them. I don’t want things like journal, notes etc. To the point and easy to use. The interactive widgets to log habits is the best feature. Beautiful UI also. We can add 3 habits in free version and there there’s lifetime upgrade option also instead of paying a subscription.
author: rangarajan_k
